scope: HTTP-only black-box; isolated SQLite state and random localhost port per case; deterministic MOCK providers

cases.name: 01-ignore-plan
cases.expected: Exactly the frozen plan [] is published, with independent receipts and no private prompt leakage

cases.name: 02-like-only-plan
cases.expected: Exactly the frozen plan ['LIKE'] is published, with independent receipts and no private prompt leakage

cases.name: 03-comment-only-plan
cases.expected: Exactly the frozen plan ['COMMENT'] is published, with independent receipts and no private prompt leakage

cases.name: 04-combined-plan
cases.expected: Exactly the frozen plan ['LIKE', 'COMMENT'] is published, with independent receipts and no private prompt leakage

cases.name: 05-comment-output-rejected
cases.expected: LIKE survives; COMMENT is REJECTED; job PARTIAL_COMPLETED

cases.name: 06-transient-provider-retry
cases.expected: One failed and one successful understanding attempt; both actions once; 4 cost units

cases.name: 07-bounded-provider-failure
cases.expected: Exactly 3 failed provider attempts; FAILED with no fake IGNORE or interactions

cases.name: 08-zero-budget-topup-recovery
cases.expected: Zero-cost failure, explicit budget top-up and retry completes without overspend

cases.name: 09-exact-budget-and-lower-limit
cases.expected: 3 units complete one job; reducing below spent returns 409; next job fails without overspend

cases.name: 10-partial-budget-action-retry
cases.expected: 2-unit budget preserves LIKE; 1-unit top-up adds COMMENT and retains LIKE receipt

cases.name: 11-unknown-receipt-reconcile
cases.expected: UNKNOWN retains reservation and prior LIKE; ordinary retry rejected; reconciliation adds one COMMENT

cases.name: 12-unknown-delete-accounting
cases.expected: Deleting UNKNOWN job hides post and cancels; receipt accounting settles without republishing

cases.name: 13-unknown-edit-accounting
cases.expected: Old UNKNOWN job remains SUPERSEDED after accounting; latest version completes with unique actions

cases.name: 14-restart-running-understand
cases.expected: SIGKILL recovers leased stage from one durable provider receipt with no double charge

cases.name: 15-restart-after-like
cases.expected: SIGKILL during COMMENT preserves LIKE receipt and recovers one COMMENT

cases.name: 16-restart-unknown-state
cases.expected: Restart preserves UNKNOWN and reserved cost until explicit reconciliation

cases.name: 17-cancel-orphan-running-receipt
cases.expected: SIGKILL then cancellation permits cost settlement of orphan RUNNING receipt, with zero interactions

cases.name: 18-concurrent-edit-version-fence
cases.expected: Two expected_version=1 edits yield one 202 and one 409; old worker remains SUPERSEDED

cases.name: 19-edit-frozen-like-plan
cases.expected: New text requesting COMMENT cannot expand a previously frozen LIKE-only plan

cases.name: 20-edit-frozen-ignore-plan
cases.expected: A committed empty decision remains empty after content edit

cases.name: 21-delete-inflight-fence
cases.expected: Delete during model call prevents late publication, hides post, and rejects retry

cases.name: 22-avatar-revocation-fence
cases.expected: Revoking candidate during decision makes both actions STALE and job FAILED

cases.name: 23-private-memory-revocation
cases.expected: Decision using a memory later revoked cannot publish or leak private content

cases.name: 24-derived-source-deletion
cases.expected: Deleting a source post revokes derived memory and fences another post's pending actions

cases.name: 25-business-deadline-fence
cases.expected: Slow job reaches EXPIRED; late provider result cannot publish or overwrite terminal status

cases.name: 26-concurrent-idempotent-submit
cases.expected: 10 simultaneous identical submissions create one post/job and exactly two independent actions

cases.name: 27-budget-survives-restart
cases.expected: Spent budget survives process death; restart cannot regain consumed units

cases.name: 28-concurrent-hard-budget
cases.expected: 10 posts with 8 workers share 5 units; spent+reserved never exceeds 5 and all jobs settle
